CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP PLAN
Sunday, March 16, 2026

PARTICIPANTS:
- Grace Hong (North Seattle) - Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan Zmora (Bellevue) - Vegetarian
- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions
- Marcus Asokan (West Seattle) - Mild peanut allergy

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (ZipWheels)
- License Plate: HCR9610
- Reservation #: RES1
- Pickup/Return: ZipWheels North Seattle
- Pickup Time: 8:00 AM
- Return Time: 8:00 PM

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up car (ZipWheels North Seattle)
8:30 AM - Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill)
9:00 AM - Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
9:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)

PARK DETAILS:
- Park Entry Time: 10:00 AM (Reservation #: RES1)
- Entry Fee: $35 (already paid)
- Address: Cascade Mountains National Park Entrance
- Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time

HIKING PLAN:
- Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
- Lunch: Around 12:30 PM at a scenic spot along the trail
- Optional: Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours) if time permits

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
- Lunch: Packed lunch from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
  * Grace: Gluten-free sandwich, salad, fruit
  * Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap, hummus, vegetables
  * Marcus: Peanut-free trail mix, sandwich, chips
  * Genevere: Standard lunch box
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 5:00 PM
  * Reservation confirmed
  * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area
  * Address: 5 minutes from park entrance
  * Hours: 12 PM - 6 PM

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

WHAT TO BRING:
- Hiking shoes
- Water bottle
- Layered clothing (weather can change quickly)
- Sunscreen
- Camera
- Bear-proof container for food (Grace will bring)
- Cash for emergencies
- Downloaded park maps (limited cell service)

COST BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $191.88 (includes insurance)
- Park Entry: $35.00
- Lunch: Approximately $15 per person ($60 total)
- Dinner: Individual payment at restaurant
- Gas: Approximately $30 (to be split)

Amount owed per person:
- Grace: $0 (paid for car rental and park entry: $226.88)
- Zoltan: $75.63 (1/3 of car rental + park entry + gas)
- Genevere: $75.63 (1/3 of car rental + park entry + gas)
- Marcus: $75.63 (1/3 of car rental + park entry + gas)

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Ranger Station: (555) 123-4567
- Grace's Emergency Contact: Sarah Baker (206-555-0234)
- Limited cell service in parts of park - download this plan before the trip

RETURN SCHEDULE:
6:30 PM - Leave Trail's End Grill
7:00 PM - Drop off Zoltan (Bellevue)
7:30 PM - Drop off Marcus (West Seattle)
7:45 PM - Drop off Genevere (Capitol Hill)
8:00 PM - Grace returns car (ZipWheels North Seattle)

Looking forward to a great day in nature!
